measurement_methods.geometry: BBox from alpha>0; height=bottom-top; foot row=bottom-1; center of mass=sum(x*alpha)/sum(alpha), coordinates0..63; partial alpha means1..254
measurement_methods.gold: Per-direction inspected spatial ROIs, native pixels; default HSV hue26..56deg, saturation>=0.45, R>=125, G>=65, B<=0.65G, with explicit material_palette_overrides taking precedence. Exact coordinates and RGB colours retained for independent recount. O-F1v2 uses the accepted v11 count. O-F2 blue scarf/visible trim use3 exact RGB shades. O-M2 uses5 unambiguous gold shades; broader brown-shadow candidates are separate. O-M3 trim uses4 actual scarf-gold shades to exclude olive/skin candidates and starts below scarf tails.
measurement_methods.scarf_thresholds: Front>=60 current acceptance. Other views>=30 recorded from prompt; rear painting explicitly deferred by v12.
measurement_methods.lantern_and_skirt: Visual classification from raw sprites at 4x and native body crops. Buckles/glove trim are not counted as lanterns per v12. This is not an automatic semantic segmentation.
measurement_methods.hands: Anatomical left/right in native64 raw frames; hidden hands marked estimated. Composite anchors separately include the exact body+whole translations. Standing pose only.
measurement_methods.assembly: Explicit masks and integer translations only, visible source RGBA preserved. Transparent RGB canonicalized in composites. Raw sheets never edited.
